mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are falling, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS are falling.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines.
